title: Discovery
description: We start by understanding your business, goals, and constraints. Through workshops, interviews, and data review, we align on the problem space and success criteria.

title: Strategy
description: We develop a clear strategy and roadmap—prioritised initiatives, timelines, and resource needs. You get actionable recommendations and optionality, not just a report.

title: Implementation
description: Where needed, we support implementation: vendor selection, design, build, and integration. We work alongside your teams to ensure sustainable ownership.

title: Ongoing support
description: We offer retainer and project-based support for follow-on work, ensuring continuity and adapting as your needs evolve.
